summary: Amesite Inc. filed an 8-K under Items 1.01, 3.02, 8.01, and 9.01 reporting a registered direct offering and concurrent private placement completed on April 27, 2026. The company sold 696,866 common shares at $1.435 per share to institutional investors in the registered direct, and separately issued pre-funded warrants at $1.434 per unit plus Series A-1 and A-2 common warrants in the private placement. Pre-funded warrants are exercisable immediately at $0.001; common warrants become exercisable after stockholder approval at $1.435 per share, with varying expiration dates. The offering relies on an effective S-3 shelf registration statement. This is a capital-raising transaction, not a special-situation event, so the category is Other. Watch for stockholder approval timeline and potential dilution from warrant exercises.
